description: This file provides utility functions, policies, and classes for module wrapping, particularly in context of PyTorch FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) training. It includes auto wrap policies, context managers for module wrapping, and strategies for selective wrapping of neural network modules.

classes.name: ModuleWrapPolicy
classes.description: Policy class that wraps modules of specified classes, passing in the root kwargs.

classes.name: CustomPolicy
classes.description: Policy class that applies a user-defined lambda function to determine wrapping and kwargs.

classes.name: _Policy
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for wrapping policies.

classes.name: _ConfigAutoWrap
classes.description: Helper class managing context and configuration for automatic module wrapping.
